A project can set one full-suite integration gate that runs once per batch of merged tasks; tasks keep focused checks; a failing gate is traced to the merged task that caused it and sent as a fix turn into that writer's thread.
Files of this area: src/native-agent-overlay.ts, src/server/integration-gate.ts, src/server/writer/dispatch.ts, src/server/writer/finish.ts, src/ui/page.tsx, tests/integration-gate.test.ts, tests/verification/integration-gate-bisect.test.ts

- Execution defaults can pin a chat environment as `folder` or `worktree`. Resolve the pin nearest-first across section, ancestors, project, and global settings. A `worktree` pin preselects a managed worktree on the folder host in both New chat and the composer chip; spawn must preserve that managed-worktree selection. With no pin, keep the existing folder/section-provider behavior. Groups must never become chat environments.
- Errand, QA, and reviewer helper threads are read-only for repository files; specialists may write under `.agents/`. Writers retain full worktree access. Wait backstops report helper edits as `repo_edited` with changed files and do not revert them.
- Full plugin backups use a versioned JSON payload (`kind: 'bb-project-folders-backup'`, version 1) containing settings and all 11 durable tables: folders, folder_paths, thread_places, folder_rules, project_rules, project_order, execution_defaults, session_policies, preferences, item_styles, and folder_archives. Imports preserve row IDs and run in one transaction; invalid backups and imports during an active move or archive are rejected. Transient tables (exports, pending_exports, project_moves, thread_moves, section_moves) are excluded. This adds no schema changes and preserves the existing appearance-only export/import flow.

When gateRun succeeds with exitCode === 0, the runner marks the gate green, clears red-gate episodes, resets merge counters (mergesSinceLastGate and mergedTasksSinceLastGate), updates lastGreenCommit, and records the evaluation in the database. When gateRun fails, it first checks whether the failure is an environment failure via isEnvironmentCheckFailure; if so, it notifies the PM without searching for culprits. Otherwise, it extracts failing tests from output using extractFailingTests, resolves failure attribution across merged tasks via host.call('gateAttribute') and attributeFailures, writes a log to .agents/plans/items/.../logs/integration-gate.log, and either dispatches a fix turn to a culprit task thread or notifies the PM chat. The task contract requires modifying this flow to handle load-induced timeouts: when all failing tests in a red gate run are timeouts, the runner must rerun the gate once before declaring a red batch. For vitest/jest commands, failing test files are appended to the rerun command; otherwise, the full command is rerun. A passing recheck must perform the standard green bookkeeping and record a 'rechecked: timeouts under load' note without dispatching fix turns or notifying the owner.
